title: reWordBench: Benchmarking and Improving the Robustness of Reward Models with Transformed Inputs

bias_targets.methodology: Filtering evaluation samples so that the compared responses differ by no more than 3 tokens in length, ensuring the reward model's win rate is not falsely inflated by a preference for simply longer sequences.

Swapping specific stylistic or structural artifacts between chosen and rejected responses (e.g., LaTeX `\boxed{}` environments versus Markdown `# Answer` headers in math problems, or minifying Python code) to evaluate if models overfit to presentation rather than reasoning quality.
